Name: Integrated Management Log
Message: DIMM Initialization Error - Processor 1 DIMMs 11, 12. The identified memory channel could not be properly trained and has been mapped out. The indicated DIMMs will not be available. (Major Code:00000001, Minor Code:00000001).
Resolution: Re-seat the specified DIMMs and update the System ROM. If the issue persists, contact support.
